open.Title: Login page crashes on empty password
open.Body: Submitting the login form with an empty password raises a panic in the handler and the page shows a 500 error instead of a message.

open.Title: Add dark mode to the dashboard
open.Body: Users want a dark theme for the dashboard board view, following the system setting, with a toggle in the header.

issue.Title: Export fails on large reports
issue.Body: Running the export for a report with more than 5000 rows returns an error after thirty seconds. Expected: the file downloads. Seen in the reports page.

issue.Title: Login page crashes on empty password
issue.Body: Submitting the login form with an empty password raises a panic in the handler and the page shows a 500 error instead of a message. Seen today.

issue.Title: Add dark theme to the dashboard
issue.Body: Users want a dark theme for the dashboard board view that follows the system setting, with a toggle in the header, so it is easy on the eyes at night.

issue.Title: Add a release job
issue.Body: Edit .github/workflows/release.yml to publish the binary on every tag, with a checksum file attached to the release page.

issue.Title: SQL injection in search
issue.Body: The search box passes the query into SQL without escaping. A crafted query returns other users' rows. Expected: the query is parameterised.

issue.Title: README typo in install steps
issue.Body: The install section says brew intall. It should say brew install. Fix the spelling in the README.

issue.Title: Handle the retry case
issue.Body: When the worker retries a ticket the second attempt should reuse the branch and not open a new pull request each time.
